name: VisionTime: Movie & TV Tracker
summary:
Every movie you watch, every show you follow — VisionTime turns them into a beautiful, personal library that grows with you.

Mark episodes as you go. Follow the actors, directors, and studios whose next project you cannot wait for, and let VisionTime quietly tell you when a release date lands — as a weekly digest, a monthly digest, with per-show controls for the series that matter most.
